en: Antique divided‑back postcard with a monochrome drawing of a fortified town surrounded by walls and mountains. A prominent city gate with a bridge leads into the town; small figures walk and ride horses in the foreground. Caption in German identifies it as Old Kronstadt and specifically the Klostergasse Gate before the great fire of 1689. The back bears Hungarian 'LEVELEZŐ‑LAP' and the publisher line.
